text: Short title, extent, commencement and application. (1) This Act may be called the Consumer Protection Act, 2019. (2) It extends to the whole of India. (3) It shall come into force on such date as the Central Government may, by notification, appoint.

text: Section 2(1): 'advertisement' means any audio or visual publicity, representation, endorsement or pronouncement made by means of light, sound, smoke, gas, print, electronic media, internet or website.
excerpt: Section 2(1): 'advertisement' definition.

text: Section 2(5): 'complainant' means a consumer, voluntary consumer association, Central/State Government, Central Authority, or legal heir/representative.
excerpt: Section 2(5): 'complainant' definition.

text: Section 2(7): 'consumer' means any person who buys goods or hires services for consideration paid or promised, excluding resale or commercial purpose.
excerpt: Section 2(7): 'consumer' definition.

text: Section 2(9): 'consumer rights' includes protection against hazardous goods, right to be informed, right to access competitive prices, right to be heard, and right to seek redressal against unfair trade practices.
excerpt: Section 2(9): 'consumer rights' definition.

text: Section 2(10): 'defect' means any fault, imperfection or shortcoming in quality, quantity, potency, purity or standard of goods required by law or contract.
excerpt: Section 2(10): 'defect' definition.

text: Section 2(11): 'deficiency' means any fault, imperfection, shortcoming or inadequacy in the quality, nature and manner of performance of a service.
excerpt: Section 2(11): 'deficiency' definition.

text: Section 2(17): 'electronic service provider' means a person who provides technologies or processes to enable advertising or selling goods/services, including online marketplaces.
excerpt: Section 2(17): 'electronic service provider' definition.

text: Section 2(28): 'misleading advertisement' means an advertisement that falsely describes a product, gives false guarantees, conveys unfair trade representations, or deliberately conceals important information.
excerpt: Section 2(28): 'misleading advertisement' definition.

text: Section 2(34): 'product liability' means the responsibility of a product manufacturer or seller to compensate for harm caused by defective product or deficiency in services.
excerpt: Section 2(34): 'product liability' definition.

text: Section 2(47): 'unfair trade practice' means a trade practice adopting unfair methods or deceptive practices including false representations of standard, quality, quantity, or grade.
excerpt: Section 2(47): 'unfair trade practice' definition.
